properties.description:
A ratio reported by one tool must carry the caveat its SOURCE tool considers essential, so a warning cannot be stripped by the tool that repeats the number.

DISTINCT FROM dec:idea-a-derived-number-carries-what-it-was-computed-over-wherever-it-is-quoted, which is the OPEN QUESTION and the four options weighed. Anthony chose (a) with (d) as a follow-on, 2026-08-30. This is what gets BUILT; that is why.

THE INSTANCE THAT PROMPTED IT, measured 2026-08-30. `seam_coverage` emits a scope_note saying a design that declares contracts at a HIGHER boundary than it records dependencies will read as uncovered at module level, and to pass `altitude`. `maturity_report`'s seams band asks the SAME question at module level with none of that warning, and `graph_report_markdown` prints `seams 18% (13/72)` barer still. The band's `not_observed_about` list is four items long and does not include the one caveat its sibling considers necessary.

⭐ WHY IT IS NOT AN AGENT-BEHAVIOUR PROBLEM. An agent reading the trajectory band has nothing to be suspicious of. Anthony named the pattern — an agent announces a number and only afterwards says what it actually measured — and asked for the ordering reversed. The reversal is not achievable by instruction alone, because the caveat is not in the number's hand at the moment it is quoted.

THE BANDS WHERE A CORRECT DESIGN READS LOW: SEAMS (answered at module level; a design declaring contracts one level up reads near zero); REALIZATION (a file nobody registered as an Artifact is invisible, so a user who has built everything and never run link-artifacts reads 0%); ASSURANCE (a capability checked only at component granularity is not counted); OPERATION (a design that never modelled an Environment reads as undeployed).

⚠️ ONLY THE SEAMS CAVEAT IS MEASURED. The other three are reasoned from the band definitions and are NOT verified against a real design exhibiting them. Recorded so a later session does not inherit four confirmed findings where there is one.

THE SECOND LEG (Anthony's (d), a follow-on rather than a substitute): where-am-i re-derives a band from its source tool before naming it the FRONTIER, because the frontier is the one band that drives what the user does next. An instruction with no detector behind it is the weakest leg, which is why it rides behind the tool-side fix.

WHAT IT MUST NOT DO: change the numbers. Moving a band's value would break comparison against every earlier reading. The caveat is added; the ratio stays.
properties.name: A derived number carries what it was computed over, wherever it is quoted
